subject: History
question: After M. Gandhiji came to India in 1915, which of the following problems did he handle successfully? a. The indigo problem of Champaran in Bihar. b. The land revenue problem of the farmers of Kheda. c. The conflict between the mill workers and the owners in Ahmedabad city. d. Creating a separate electorate for Muslims.
explanation: Gandhi's first three mass struggles after returning to India were all local, non-violent satyagrahas: Champaran indigo (1917), Kheda revenue (1918), and the Ahmedabad textile mill strike (1918). Separate Muslim electorates came from constitutional reform politics (Montagu–Chelmsford, 1919)—Gandhi did not 'handle' that as a successful campaign. Options mixing in 'd' trap students who lump every pre-Independence issue under Gandhi.

question: सन 1915 मध्ये म. गांधीजी भारतात आल्यानंतर पुढीलपैकी कोणते प्रश्न त्यांनी यशस्वीपणे हाताळले? अ. बिहार मधील चंपारण्यातील निळीचा प्रश्न. ब. खेडा येथील शेतकऱ्यांचा शेतसारा प्रश्न. क. अहमदाबाद शहरातील मील मजूर आणि मालक यांच्यातील संघर्ष. ड. मुस्लीमासाठी स्वतंत्र मतदार संघाची निर्मिती करणे.
explanation: पर्याय A ('अ', 'ब' आणि 'क') — स्वतंत्र मुस्लिम मतदारसंघ मॉन्टेग्यू–चेम्सफोर्ड (१९१९) संविधान सुधारणांतून आले — गांधीजींनी ते यशस्वी म्हणून हाताळले नाही। 'd' मिसळणारे पर्याय स्वातंत्र्यपूर्व काळातील प्रत्येक मुद्दा गांधीजींच्या खात्यात टाकणारे सापळे पर्याय B ('अ', 'क' आणि 'ड') या प्रश्नात विचारलेल्या व्याख्या/तथ्याशी जुळत नाही; पर्याय C ('ब', 'ड' आणि 'अ') या प्रश्नाच्या मुख्य संकल्पनेशी सुसंगत नाही; पर्याय D ('अ', 'ब', 'क' आणि 'ड') या प्रश्नाच्या मुख्य संकल्पनेशी सुसंगत नाही।

subject: Reasoning
question: Rani and Suresh are a married couple have two daughters Medha and Deepti. Deepti is married to Anurag who is the son of Gareema and Tushar. Nidhi is the daughter of Anurag. Komal who is Anurag's sister is married with Harshit and has two sons, Aman and Prem. Prem is the grandson of Garima and Tushar, what is relation between Deepti and Komal?
explanation: Deepti married Anurag (son of Garima–Tushar); Komal is Anurag's sister married to Harshit—so Deepti and Komal are sisters-in-law (brother's wife ↔ brother's wife's sister-in-law axis). Aunt/niece or blood-sister options ignore the marriage link through Anurag.
